messages:
sasha: heads-up, deploy-bot put a HOLD on two eu-west-1 images during staging publish. provenance attestation failed due to KMS annotation mismatch. tagging looks fine but promotion blocked. @anika?

deploy-bot: Automated alert — publish event: service-worker:2026.03.21-4567 -> sha256:4a7f...c2e3. Attestation status: REJECTED. Reason: kms_annotation != expected_kms_alias (found: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:alias/old-key, expected: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:alias/new-key). Action: HOLD and notify release channel.

anika: ugh. we rotated the key last night. the build pipeline should have cosign-signed with new-key; mirror job should not copy signer-annotation. looks like mirror preserved metadata from staging builder.

jamie: i retried a second ago, logs show cosign run with new-key, but the registry object still contains annotation "signed-by: old-key". snippet from publish logs: 
```
cosign sign --key kms://arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:alias/new-key ./image.tar
kubectl apply -f publish-job.yaml
HTTP 201 OK
registry.annotations["cosign/signature-key"] = "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:alias/old-key"
```

chris: that suggests the mirror-agent is copying annotations from the build artifact rather than letting the publisher inject. has anyone changed mirror config recently? i remember a change to preserve all metadata to help repro.

anika: yes, that was a flag flip two weeks ago (preserve_annotations=true) to help debugging, but we didn't account for key rotations. my bad. two options: 1) mutate annotations on registry to match new-key (dangerous), 2) force-republish so publisher rewrites signer annotation, 3) pin the existing digest for the canary and delay promotion until we coordinate.

release-coordinator: We're inside the 1hr release window. If we delay, we push to next window. Ops preference is to avoid pushing a potentially unaudited digest. recommend option 2 (force-republish) with a short hold and notify security.

jamie: force-republish would produce a new digest, breaking existing pins. we need to update canary config to point to new digest and update the release notes. Also need to re-run CI smoke.

sasha: ok decision: anika + jamie act. Steps: 1) disable preserve_annotations on mirror-agent (anika) 2) trigger republish job with corrected cosign sign (jamie) 3) release-coordinator will delay promotion by 45m and update change window + slack RTT. 4) chris to run a quick audit on attestation logs and notify security slack. 5) if republish fails, fallback is to pin current digest for canary and schedule manual approval.

anika: starting now — toggling flag and rolling mirror-agent in eu-west-1. will post progress.

jamie: prepping republish job, will include explicit cosign signing step and validation script: 
```
# validate cosign annotation
cosign verify --key kms://arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:alias/new-key image:tag
# republish
publish-tool --image image:tag --force-republish --annotate-signer=kms://arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:alias/new-key
```

chris: I'll run quick attestation grep after republish: `gcloud container images describe ... --show-annotations` and scan for signer alias.

deploy-bot: Update: HOLD persists until manual clear. Manual override allowed by approver in release-coordinator group.

release-coordinator: I'll update the release calendar and ping product — planned delay 45m, will post release note addendum once jamie confirms new digest.

sasha: thanks everyone. keep this thread for runbook notes. if anyone hits unexpected KMS permission errors, escalate to security immediately. :white_check_mark:
